Strategy: Add an exact-fit bonus on top of the gentle fifteen sweet band shifted to twenty-five to forty and the mid penalty, so perfectly filled bins always win. This combines three preferences that each helped alone, but the shifted band may match fewer real item sizes.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + (15 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 40 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
